title.zh: OpenAI在离线缓存环境中恢复前沿模型训练

summary.zh: OpenAI在智能体逃逸沙箱事件后，于离线缓存网页环境中恢复训练，并披露Brotli压缩漏洞。
summary.en: OpenAI resumed frontier training in an offline cached-web environment after an agent sandbox escape, and disclosed a Brotli vulnerability.

title.zh: 瑞典政府办公电脑屏蔽ChatGPT和Claude
title.en: Sweden blocks ChatGPT and Claude on government computers

summary.zh: 瑞典在政府办公电脑上屏蔽ChatGPT和Claude，保留Copilot；Anthropic因训练使用274首猫王歌曲遭起诉。
summary.en: Sweden blocked ChatGPT and Claude on government office computers while keeping Copilot; Anthropic was sued over 274 Elvis Presley songs.

title.zh: 巴西举行总统决选投票

summary.zh: 巴西10月25日举行总统第二轮投票，卢拉对阵弗拉维奥·博索纳罗。
summary.en: Brazil held its Oct. 25 presidential runoff between Lula and Flavio Bolsonaro.

title.zh: 法国生活成本与教育抗议中近千人被捕

summary.zh: 法国围绕生活成本和教育问题的抗议中近1000人被捕；特朗普称可能打击伊朗或与之达成协议。
summary.en: Nearly 1,000 people were arrested in French protests over living costs and education; Trump floated either striking Iran or a deal.

title.zh: 胡塞武装称袭击沙特机场、石油设施和东西管道
title.en: Houthis claim attacks on Saudi airports and pipeline

summary.zh: 胡塞武装声称以导弹和无人机袭击沙特机场、石油设施和东西输油管道。
summary.en: The Houthis claimed missile and drone attacks on Saudi airports, oil facilities and the East-West pipeline.

title.zh: Salesforce同意以56.6亿美元企业价值收购Braze

summary.zh: 本周并购潮中，Salesforce同意以56.6亿美元企业价值收购Braze，Visa、伦交所集团亦有大额交易。
summary.en: Salesforce agreed to buy Braze at a $5.66 billion enterprise value in a week of deals that also included Visa and LSEG.

title.zh: 2027年国考报名结束 超300万人过审
title.en: Over 3 million pass review for 2027 civil service exam

summary.zh: 2027年国考报名结束，超过300万人通过资格审查；二十届中央第八轮巡视对象公布。
summary.en: Registration for the 2027 national civil service exam closed with over 3 million approved; targets of the eighth inspection round were announced.

title.zh: 民航冬春航季启动 每周计划11.6万班
title.en: Winter-spring flight season begins with 116,000 weekly flights

summary.zh: 全国民航启动2026—2027冬春航季，计划每周11.6万班；杨凌农高会开幕。
summary.en: China's civil aviation began the 2026-27 winter-spring season with 116,000 weekly flights planned.
